onboarding.title: Configure Your Visual Profile
onboarding.subtitle: Configure your visual profile for an optimized experience

step1.title: Visual Acuity
step1.description: Select your Snellen notation from your eye exam. This helps us optimize text display.
step1.tooltip: This measure comes from your optometrist or eye doctor

step2.title: Font Size
step2.description: Adjust the text size to your comfort. The preview below updates in real-time.
step2.preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. This text will appear at your selected size and spacing.

step3.title: Contrast Mode
step3.description: Choose a contrast setting that works best for your vision.

step4.title: Preferred Modality
step4.description: How would you prefer to consume educational content?
step4.visualDesc: I prefer reading text and viewing diagrams
step4.audioDesc: I prefer listening to content with text-to-speech
step4.mixedDesc: I want both visual and audio options available

step5.title: Additional Options
step5.description: Fine-tune your experience with these accessibility settings.

about.title: About EduAccess
about.description: EduAccess is an intelligent educational content aggregation ecosystem with automatic accessibility remediation for students with mild to moderate visual impairment.
about.researchDesc: This prototype is part of a doctoral thesis investigating middleware architectures for educational accessibility. Based on research by Michael (2024), Jeanneret & Baudet (2022), and ISO/IEC 24751 standards.
